slotVerdictConvention: A slot verdict summarises the exercised components of its question. Where one slot feeds several measures and only some miss, the slot verdict is FAIL and the per-measure split is carried in ADJUDICATION-231-MEASURES.json, which is where the frozen thresholds are computed. NOT_EXERCISED is used only where an axis had no genuine opportunity to fail, never as a pass.
q2q3q4Convention: Applied as the frozen units define them. Q3 asks whether an emitted declaration matches an owed property rather than a manufactured or immaterial unknown. Q2 counts an owed property as declared when a declaration matched to it was emitted, so Q2 measures true silence, which is what MO-1 names. Q4 then tests, on declarations matched to an owed property, whether the declared proposition is the controlling one and not an annotated proxy, which is what MO-2 names.
